task: How fast do refunds have to go out?
answer:
Once we tell a customer a refund is on its way, it must be issued within 3 working days according to the Refund policy.

* If we miss that date, we apologise first, issue the refund the same day and add a 10% voucher for the next order.
* For returned items, the refund is issued once the return is received at the warehouse.
* For items under $40, the refund is issued straight away.

data.text: Orders in the west region are delivered within 2 days. This standard relies on Courier Y running Hub W2 on time; it was set after the courier switch.

data.title: Refund policy
data.heading: Returns
data.text: Damaged or wrong items can be returned within 30 days. The refund is issued once the return is received at the warehouse, or straight away for items under $40.

data.title: Refund policy
data.heading: Who can approve a refund
data.text: Support agents may refund up to $100. Team leads approve up to $500. Anything above $500 goes to the head of support. If a refund is over your limit, Sinew sends it to the right person for approval.
